name: ulana-godot-agent-tools
description: Lazy Toolbox registration for Ulana Godot Agent Tools, the local Codex-to-Godot bridge used by Vector Overdrive.

toolsets.title: Ulana Godot Agent Tools
toolsets.description: Inspect stock Godot projects, run safe headless project checks, and coordinate with the Ulana Godot editor addon through a local file bridge.
examples: Inspect Vector Overdrive project metadata and scene/script/resource summaries before game development work.
Run the Godot headless validate_project operation after changing scenes, scripts, or project settings.
Check whether the editor addon bridge is active before sending file-bridge commands.
recipes: Start with godot_detect_installations and godot_get_project_info, then read godot://project resources for compact project context.
Use godot_run_headless_operation with validate_project for safe stock-Godot validation after edits.
Call editor_bridge_get_status before editor_bridge_send_command; a missing or stale session means the editor addon is not currently polling.
toolsets.activation_hint: Activate for Godot project work, Vector Overdrive setup, headless Godot validation, or editor addon bridge commands.

guidance_sources.title: Godot Bridge Agent Guide
guidance_sources.summary: How agents should use the Ulana Godot bridge without keeping it always-on.
guidance_sources.content: Use this toolset only when a task needs Godot or Vector Overdrive context. Treat C:\Dev\Vector_Overdrive as the working game repo and C:\Dev\Godot_MCP as the bridge repo. Prefer godot_get_project_info and compact godot://project resources before reading many files. Use godot_run_headless_operation only for allowlisted operations such as validate_project, scan_scenes, and scan_resources. Check editor_bridge_get_status before editor_bridge_send_command; if the status is missing_session, missing_heartbeat, mismatched_session, or stale, do not assume the Godot editor addon is available. The Codex registration name is ulana-godot-agent-tools, while the Toolbox namespace is ulana_godot_agent_tools.

composition_examples.title: Vector Overdrive Readiness Snapshot
composition_examples.summary: Collect project metadata, validate the project headlessly, and inspect editor bridge availability.
